name: Collar x Malice: The V-Day Incident!
source:
On Valentine’s Day, Shinjuku police officer Ichika Hoshino receives a mysterious present! Who could it be from? Join Ichika and investigate alongside your favorites to solve the V-Day Incident once and for all! 

[From [url=https://rikaisha.itch.io/collar-malice-vday]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
情人节，新宿警官星野一香收到了一份神秘礼物！它可能来自谁？与一花一起，与你最爱的人一起调查，一劳永逸地解决情人节事件！

[来自[url=https://rikaisha.itch.io/collar-malice-vday]Itch.io[/url]]
